# Determine classical songs among all unique song_ids in playlist library
classical_genre = 'classical'

classical_song_ids = set()
classical_song_to_artist_ids = {}

song_ids_sorted = sorted(all_song_ids)
print('unique_song_ids', len(song_ids_sorted))

for idx, sid in enumerate(song_ids_sorted):
    song = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)  # keyword arg
    genre = song.get('genre')
    if genre == classical_genre:
        classical_song_ids.add(sid)
        artist_ids = [a['id'] for a in song.get('artists', [])]
        classical_song_to_artist_ids[sid] = set(artist_ids)
    if idx < 5:
        print('song_debug', sid, 'genre', genre, 'artists', [a.get('id') for a in song.get('artists', [])])

classical_artist_ids = set()
for sid, aset in classical_song_to_artist_ids.items():
    classical_artist_ids |= aset
